verdict.rationale: Follow Up Boss documents a public REST API, so asking about API versioning and deprecation is fair for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions API version identifiers, version pinning, or any deprecation or sunset policy. A REST API on its own does not show versioning or a deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
